name: Nelson Mandela
description: Anti-apartheid revolutionary who emerged from 27 years in prison to negotiate the peaceful end of white-minority rule, win South Africa's first universal election in 1994, and pursue reconciliation through the Truth and Reconciliation Commission.

name: Martin Luther King Jr.
description: Baptist minister who led the American civil-rights movement through nonviolent mass action — Montgomery, Birmingham, the March on Washington and 'I Have a Dream' — winning the Civil Rights and Voting Rights Acts before his assassination in Memphis.

name: Rosalind Franklin
description: X-ray crystallographer whose Photo 51 and analyses were decisive evidence for DNA's double helix, used without her knowledge by Watson and Crick. She later did foundational virus-structure work before dying at 37.

name: Yuri Gagarin
description: Soviet cosmonaut who became the first human in space aboard Vostok 1 on 12 April 1961, orbiting Earth once in 108 minutes and instantly becoming a global icon of the space age.
